exposure: ST analysis of the fetal electrocardiogram during labor
cohort: 20 healthy women with an uncomplicated pregnancy monitored with ST analysis during labor: 10 cases (umbilical cord artery pH < 7.05) and 10 controls (pH > 7.20)
finding: The study observed higher positive and lower negative likelihood ratios for relative ST analysis in comparison to absolute ST analysis, suggesting potential for improved accuracy in detecting fetal acidemia, but found no statistically significant difference in this small study.
